# Accio

> Accio is an AI-powered sourcing engine that helps businesses find suppliers and optimize procurement strategies globally.

Accio provides B2B sourcing solutions partnered with Alibaba, offering AI business agents and practical tools for ecommerce and procurement. The platform serves international users with compliance across EU, GDPR, CCPA, and other regional regulations.

## Key Topics

- AI sourcing engine
- B2B procurement
- Supplier discovery
- Profit margin optimization
- Purchase orders
- GDPR compliance
- CCPA compliance
- EU DSA compliance
- International sourcing
- Ecommerce
- Alibaba integration
- User authorization
- Data privacy
- Global trade
